summary: Alanna left. On 10/22 at 11:08 she wrote 'Heyyy, I've decided to move to a different management team. Thank you for everything though, I really appreciate it!' and nobody at ALTR has replied in the 8 days to the window close on 10/30. No owner message, no acknowledgement, no final invoice, no ledger statement, no confirmation that ALTR has logged out of her OnlyFans. The exit followed a two-week window that started like a recovery. After zero client messages in the prior week, she sent 17 messages between 10/17 and 10/22 and raised 5 asks: a Zelle request for invoice #5 (10/17), a bulk handover of new solo content and three collab movies with 'can you please upload and send out' (10/18), tags for the collabs (10/18), 'Everything uploaded ok?' (10/19), and open video-call availability for the chatters to sell (10/21). ALTR's handling: Melissa posted the first earnings and performance report on this account on 10/16 (74 days in), with the DMCA update folded in, and Mayson announced the new Friday format. Stephski chased invoice #5 on 10/17; the client again had to ask for a Zelle request (third invoice running) and Stephski sent it 40 hours later on 10/19. Mayson flagged Ollie Mckinlay 6 hours after the 10/18 handover and Ollie, who had posted twice since 9/14, sent 6 messages in three days: 'Will get these queued and sent out', a tags question, and a screenshot that the Leolulu video would not upload. Her 'Everything uploaded ok?' on 10/19 was answered only about the failing file ('No this one still won't upload on my end', 10/20); nothing confirmed that the other 15 folders were queued or posted. On 10/21 she said the file uploaded fine on her other page, i.e. she did it herself. Her 10/21 video-call availability got no reply at all. The last ALTR activity she saw before resigning was a heads-up about test messages and six 'test message for new system (please disregard)' posts from Antonio Veritrade, added to the group that evening. One detail from the handover matters for the record: three of the eight 'new solo content' folders she sent on 10/18 are the exact 9/12 and 9/13 sexting-set folders, which is written evidence that those sets were never posted in the 36 days ALTR held them. Open ages at exit: 5,000+ photos unacknowledged 50 days, release calendar empty 62 days, live-pause instruction 72 days, alannaworldx0 takedown 87 days, IG account promised 59 days ago, Drive/Dropbox ingestion proof 36 days, Mayson's login/call asks 63-77 days, Calendly call 88 days. Money: invoice #5 (Oct 1-14) was due about 10/22, the day she left; the Zelle request went out 10/19 and no receipt is in chat. Invoices #2, #3 and #4 have never been confirmed paid in chat (52, 38 and 22 days past due if unpaid). No closing invoice for Oct 15-22 has been issued. If these are not reconciled now they fall off the dashboard with her. Churn read: the exit matched the book's signature. Derrek's last non-billing message was 9/24; the 30-day line fell on 10/24, two days after she quit, and he never sent the outreach flagged in the last two reports. Long-promised deliverables had no written proof, and the one results-type question she asked in-window ('Everything uploaded ok?') never got a full written answer. The asks-to-zero alarm fired on 10/9 and 10/16; the 10/17-10/21 burst was her clearing her content and settling up, not a return. Security: no credentials were posted in-window. Her 10/21 message states her local time zone and city; the city is left out of this file. ALTR still holds her OnlyFans login from 8/3 and should confirm logout in writing.

health.rationale: Down 23 from 27. The client resigned in writing on 10/22 ('I've decided to move to a different management team') and ALTR has not replied in 8 days, so there is no partial credit for the relationship. The score sits at 4 rather than 0 because the exit is clean, not hostile: she thanked the team, she had just settled invoice #5 by asking for the Zelle request herself, and there is no dispute, chargeback or public complaint in the chat. It is a point below Amber Haze (5, exit unanswered 4 days) and level with Alex Paige Moore (4, exit unanswered 8 days) because the silence here is total and the ledger is worse: four invoices (#2-#5) have no receipt in chat and no closing invoice exists. What moved it from 27: (1) the exit itself; (2) zero owner response, continuing a 36-day non-billing silence from Derrek that the last two reports flagged with a 10/24 deadline; (3) her 10/21 video-call availability and her 10/19 'Everything uploaded ok?' went unanswered or half-answered, so the final interactions repeated the pattern that drove the 9/24 blow-up; (4) the 10/18 re-send of the September sexting-set folders proves the long-promised content work never happened. Offsets that do not change the outcome but belong on the record: first earnings/performance report delivered 10/16; fourth consecutive leak update; Ollie engaged with the 10/18 handover within 6 hours and asked for tags; Stephski sent the Zelle request on request; the never-ask-her-to-upload-to-ALTR's-Drive rule held.
